messages:
Priya Nair: Quick heads-up — we're enabling a Data Residency Enforcement mode for Private/VPC customers in two weeks. Enforcement constrains traffic and persisted telemetry to tenant-configured regions. Internal docs/rollout: https://redwood.internal/docs/private/data-residency-enforce

Marta Gomez: Legal note — customers must sign the updated DPA before enforcement is enabled. I'll post the template and signature instructions.

Leo Park: Infra update — implemented as per-tenant toggle (`data_residency_mode: enforced|advisory`). When `enforced` we block egress to non-authorized regions at the edge router. Config preview:
```yaml
tenant_config:
  data_residency_mode: enforced
  allowed_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
```
Landing in Private agent v2.6 + Console v3.1.

Sam Reynolds: Who handles customer comms? Need FAQ + opt-in flow for pilot customers. Also, migration impact for cross-region DR?

Priya Nair: CS owns comms — Sam please draft the FAQ. Leo, add a DR appendix with compliant DR patterns. Rollout plan: Week 0: toggle on for dogfood tenants; Week 1: pilot on request; Week 2: opt-in window; Week 3: enforcement for tenants with signed DPA.

Marta Gomez: Sales checklist needed for contract amendments and pricing notes — I'll post in #sales today.

Compliance Bot: AUTOMATED: Created ticket #COM-4721. Actions: review DPA text, confirm audit trail retention, validate telemetry-minimization mode. SLA: 7d.

CS Ops: Runbook uploaded: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-data-residency.md — includes troubleshooting, rollback steps, and on-call contact matrix.

Sam Reynolds: I'll drop the FAQ draft by EOD tomorrow and ping @Marta for legal review.

Priya Nair: Thanks — owners: CS (FAQ/comms: Sam), Legal (DPA: Marta), Infra (config + DR: Leo), Support (runbook validation: CS Ops). Ping me for blockers. :lock: :earth_americas:
